reason: This session built a feature (per-episode character updates) to fix NPC speaker errors, ran a $0.63 chain benchmark, and only afterwards found it could not work. 263 of the 265 target errors had the correct answer missing from the candidate list the feature improves. A free, read-only ceiling check run first would have shown that. The benchmark comparison was also biased: the reference reused cached output that the gold had been corrected from, so a fresh run against it looks worse. Both are reusable rules for any accuracy experiment in a multi-stage ML/LLM pipeline.
